purpose: Single-run diagnostic A/B for the eligible historical-pass regression at Order 90. Expose reusable contact CSV export and spreadsheet file conversion as staged generic Multi-Apps facades. This prior-outcome-selected run is not a baseline denominator.
hypothesis: The v210 failure had both required deterministic capabilities only behind the broad nested adapter.call route. Qwen exported the contacts successfully, but repeatedly called Calc workbook.convert_file with source_path even though the nested downstream schema required input_path, then created an incomplete workbook and tried an unrelated presentation conversion route. The eligible v51 historical pass eventually used input_path correctly and passed, but only after 30 steps and 15 errors. If explicit contact CSV export followed by spreadsheet conversion exposes two staged flat actions with model-friendly public contracts, Qwen can choose the address book and both paths unchanged while the Multi-Apps Adapter performs only the documented source_path-to-input_path representation conversion behind the spreadsheet facade.
change_scope: A focused contact_spreadsheet_semantics module detects reusable contact CSV export and local CSV/ODS/XLSX conversion intent without parsing address-book names, paths, filenames, task identity, or answer values. The strict surface stages contacts.export_csv before spreadsheet.convert_file when both operations are requested. Multi-Apps owns flat schemas for the two facades, forwards contact arguments unchanged to Thunderbird, and maps the public spreadsheet source_path field to Calc workbook.convert_file input_path inside the explicit Adapter contract. Tool search prioritizes the facades and suppresses duplicate nested routes. The Runner does not select, rewrite, inject, or infer any model-facing argument.

sources.v210_outcome: Strict evidence-valid failure: reward 0.0, generic_api_only, 18 steps, no Agent termination, and stalled_no_progress. Qwen exported contacts.csv successfully through nested adapter.call, then repeatedly used source_path against Calc workbook.convert_file, whose downstream schema required input_path, and later created an incomplete workbook and selected an unrelated presentation conversion route.
sources.historical_clean_pass_outcome: Reward 1.0 and current strict re-audit valid, evidence-valid, and baseline-admissible with zero task/golden leakage and zero model/Runner argument mismatches. Qwen eventually selected nested Thunderbird contacts.export_csv and Calc workbook.convert_file with input_path, but used all 30 steps, produced 15 errors, and did not terminate through the Agent protocol.

implementation_evidence.counterfactuals: Different address books and destinations exercise contact export; different CSV, ODS, and XLSX pairs exercise conversion. Negative cases reject EML export, JSON contact backup, opening a CSV, creating a new workbook, and video conversion. A structurally different Research Team CSV-to-ODS workflow proves the strict surface exposes only one business action per stage, both LiteAgent calls and all model-facing arguments reach the executor unchanged, the Adapter alone performs the documented field-name conversion, completion requires both public actions, and the final surface is propose_done only. Schema tests reject task_id, relative paths, missing fields, unsupported formats, and identical source/destination paths.
implementation_evidence.focused_tests: 747 passed across contact/spreadsheet semantics, strict staged tool surface, schema and forwarding behavior, Multi-Apps catalog, generic routing/completion, runtime module ownership, and strict schema-manifest validation
implementation_evidence.ruff: passed for active source, scripts, tests, and Adapters

selection.method: same fixed eligible regression item, first evidence-backed reusable hypothesis after comparing the preserved v210 requests with the current strict re-audit of the historical clean pass
